content: Your birth chart features a Cancer Ascendant rising at 15.93°, shaping your fundamental approach to life with integrity, purpose, and strong personal principles.
Your Moon is placed in Cancer under Ashlesha Nakshatra (Pada 3), granting high mental acuity, intuitive perception, and emotional depth in social and professional environments.
Belonging to the Rakshasa Gana and Antya Nadi, your temperament balances high intellect with moral responsibility, allowing you to project calm authority under pressure.
